title: Meta agrees to pause issuing nonvoting Class C shares during lawsuits by investors opposing its plan to fund AI investments without diluting Zuckerberg's stake (Sabrina Willmer/Bloomberg)
summary: Sabrina Willmer / Bloomberg: Meta agrees to pause issuing nonvoting Class C shares during lawsuits by investors opposing its plan to fund AI investments without diluting Zuckerberg's stake — Meta Platforms Inc. said it will hold off on distributing a new class of shares while a legal fight plays out with investors …
